en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Usman Bin Isa, from Sama’at who said,
‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the child, when can he Fast?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When he is strong upon the Fasting’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ahmad ibn Muhammad from has narrated from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from Sama‘ah, who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a child when he is required to fast.
He (the Imam) said, ‘When he is able to fast he must fast.’”
